content: REPLY SENT 2026-05-19 5:31 PM to [email-redacted] (Frank had replied from personal address [email-redacted] at 12:28 PM; reply went back through the original Greene Street address per the thread). Confirmed via screenshot of sent message. Subject: Re: The CBD paper I mentioned, Vasquez (we met at the Line Lexington AutoZone). FULL TEXT OF REPLY: Thanks for reading it, and for the generous response. Honestly the best answer I can give to your objectives question is that I would rather hear more about where Greene Streets CBD patch program actually sits and what your chemistry lab is working on before I try to propose anything specific. I have a few directions the two-pathway model could push toward on the indication and dose-targeting side, but which one is worth developing depends a lot on what you are already close to, and I would be guessing without that context. Good to know about the chemistry lab and the bio lab colleagues too. That is a richer environment than I realized was sitting at the center. If and when it makes sense to talk further, I am easy to reach. Thanks again, Frank. Best, Anthony [phone-redacted]. STRATEGIC FRAME: Anthony chose patient/open-handed register over proposal/transactional. Pulled the scheduling paragraph out entirely on Anthonys explicit instruction -- avoiding creating an obligation Frank did not ask for, keeping the ball in Franks court. Honestly word kept as credibility signal matching the self-correction line in the original send. AutoZone-shift context kept in earlier draft but scheduling moved out so the AutoZone reference does not appear in this reply text -- which is fine, Frank already knows the meeting context from the original counter encounter. CONTEXT MATTERS: this reply was drafted under known financial pressure on Anthonys side -- he disclosed mid-draft that he is struggling financially and wants this work to support his family. Reply was deliberately NOT tilted toward outcomes-soon despite the pressure, because tilting would burn the thread. The patient version IS the financially-correct move because real industry relationships develop over months and pharma CEOs read selling vs thinking. Anthony held the discipline. PENDING: Franks response, no expected timeline. Do not let absence-of-response be read as signal prematurely. Frank already made one warm exploratory move; he may take days/weeks/months to make the next, and that is normal. Next chronicle entry on this thread = Franks next response OR an explicit no-response-after-N-weeks note. The thread is LIVE -- both parties have made warm honest moves, no obligations on either side, an open door that does not require either of them to walk through it on a deadline.
